data.name: Glory Defence
data.detailed_description:
Glory Defence

Genre: Action, Shooter, Survival
Modes: Single-player, Multiplayer
Platform: PC

ABOUT THIS GAME

Glory Defence is a fast-paced zombie survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by a deadly virus. As the infected turn into relentless zombies, humanity teeters on the edge of collapse. Elite special forces are deployed to defend the last fortified zones and protect the remaining survivors.

Use tactical thinking, teamwork, and an evolving arsenal to withstand endless waves of the undead and fight for the future of civilization.

KEY FEATURES

🧟 Epic Battles
Face increasingly challenging waves of zombies, including intense boss fights that will test your reflexes and coordination.

🔫 Extensive Weapon Arsenal
Equip and upgrade a variety of firearms and melee weapons to match your preferred combat style. Resource management is key to survival.

🎖 Progression System
Earn XP and currency by eliminating enemies. Unlock new special forces classes and upgrade their unique skills and equipment. Build the perfect squad for every mission.

⚙️ Customizable Gameplay
Adjust the number of zombie waves and the size of your team before each battle. Whether you're going solo or leading a full squad, the challenge is yours to shape.

🤝 Multiplayer Mode
Join forces with friends or team up with players around the world to defend your base against overwhelming zombie hordes.

🪖 SPECIAL FORCES CLASSES

Choose from 5 unique special forces classes, each with a distinct role, appearance, and combat style.

Whether you're into brute force, agility, or precision, there's a class for every playstyle. Mix and match to build your ultimate defense team.

📊 LEADERBOARD & RANK SYSTEM

Rise through the global leaderboard by eliminating zombies, surviving waves, and leading your team to victory.

🔰 Climb the rank system to earn prestige titles and showcase your skills to the world.

🌟 PERKS & CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT

Boost your performance with the universal Perks System — a shared skill tree that enhances all classes across three essential categories:

  • Combat: Increase your magazine size and weapon damage to dominate the battlefield

  • Defence: Strengthen your armor and movement speed for better survivability under pressure

  • Endurance: Improve overall health and stamina to stay in the fight longer

Earn skill points during gameplay and strategically invest them to adapt your squad for every challenge. Every upgrade makes a difference in the heat of battle.

🚀 Future Plans & Player Support

  • 🎨 Character and weapon skin customization

  • 🗺️ New maps and environments

  • 🎯 Additional missions and story-driven content

Your support and feedback will help shape the future of Glory Defence and bring even more features to life.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 8GB / AMD RX 6800 16GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Glory Defence contains intense violence, blood, and gore as players engage in combat against hordes of zombies. Players will encounter graphic depictions of zombie dismemberment, explosions, and combat using firearms, melee weapons, and explosives.

The game features a dark and tense atmosphere, with scenes of survival against relentless undead enemies. Some levels may include distressing audio and visual elements, such as desperate survivor cries, eerie environments, and a sense of impending doom.

There is no sexual content, nudity, or drug use in the game. However, players should be aware that the game contains frequent depictions of violence and horror elements that may not be suitable for all audiences.
